name: Clock
description: A clock in your own time and in UTC, a stopwatch with laps, a countdown timer and an alarm that counts down to a time of day, in one tab. They keep running in UXDuck with the page closed and after it restarts, and look the same in every window.

commands.name: stopwatch-start
commands.title: Start the stopwatch
commands.description: Starts the stopwatch, or carries on after Stop.

commands.name: stopwatch-lap
commands.title: Lap
commands.description: Writes down the stopwatch's time as a lap and keeps it running.

commands.name: stopwatch-reset
commands.title: Reset the stopwatch
commands.description: Stops the stopwatch at zero and clears its laps.

commands.name: timer-start
commands.title: Start a timer
commands.description: Counts down from a number of minutes, replacing any timer running, and says so when the time is up.

commands.name: timer-add
commands.title: Add a minute to the timer
commands.description: Adds the specified number of minutes to the timer, or one minute if unspecified. Starts a timer if none is running.

commands.name: alarm-set
commands.title: Set the alarm
commands.description: Rings at a moment within the next week, replacing any alarm set, and counts down to it. The moment is in seconds since 1970.

commands.name: alarm-snooze
commands.title: Snooze the alarm
commands.description: Rings again in a number of minutes, five if not said.
